items.back: A closure by decree that must strike before it can be known, since the warning would itself start the run it exists to stop, so it lands unsaid in the hours the holder cannot act: the Friday night, the bank holiday, the Sunday address. Greek banks did not open on Monday 29 June 2015 after a Sunday address; the Cypriot bank holiday of March 2013 was stretched, after parliament refused the first levy, until the bail-in was law; the Argentine corralito was told to people on a Saturday in December 2001; the export licence suspended and the delisting published after it had already happened. Lost: a permission, the leave to carry what is yours out of the building. Carrier: the authority's calendar, laid over the hours in which the holder cannot act. Threshold: the decree itself; by construction no notice precedes it, and waiting for a date is waiting for the one thing the mechanism forbids itself from giving. Tell: none by design. Changed next move: move on a rumour and pay twice, in the chance of being wrong and in the discount the rumour market charges; the deposits that left Greece that spring left on whispers. Beside runway-illusions' Cash behind glass, which counts the deposit taken into receivership on a Friday as yours and unreachable; this item chose the Friday. Not investor-tells' Let it lapse, a fuse a founder can test by letting it burn: a closure that can be probed is not one that must surprise. Not a withdrawn offer or a rival's foreclosure, which someone at the holder's own table decides; here a rule fell on a whole class and nobody decided about the holder. The decree forbade the exit by name; the exit did not die as a side effect.

Bar date in the newspaper. A last day fixed on someone else's docket and served by publication, so the law imputes knowledge to the very people it could not reach. The bankruptcy court sets a bar date for proofs of claim and tells the creditors it cannot name by printing it in a newspaper; the class settlement's opt-out date arrives on a postcard that looks like an advertisement and goes in the bin; the probate creditor's window opens and shuts after the notice runs in the county paper. Lost: a permission, the standing to be paid or to sue on one's own behalf. Carrier: the bar-date order, with the rule of constructive notice beside it, under which publication counts as knowledge for anyone the debtor could not name. Threshold: the printed date. Tell: none reaches the holder; the person who would have filed is, by construction, the person who was not told, so the filing is the cheapest in all of law and the one least often made. Changed next move: a single page, a proof of claim or a signed opt-out. Beside runway-illusions' Stamp's clock, where the permission carries a date readable on the stamp; this is the date written somewhere the holder was not. Not deal-deaths' Missing witness: nothing is missing from the record, only the holder from the room.

A permission granted under a parent instrument carries no date of its own and ends on the parent's date, whatever the grant's merits. The emergency-use authorization ends when the declaration it was issued under is terminated, a different paper from the public-health emergency that ended in May 2023 and left the authorizations standing; the cross-state telehealth licence lapsed with each state's emergency in 2021 and 2022; the wartime power; the pilot programme run under a waiver; the sub-lease that dies with the head lease. Lost: a permission. Carrier: the parent instrument's date. Threshold: the parent's termination. Tell: the grant the holder read carries no date, so before the clock can be watched the holder must find which parent paper it is written on. Changed next move: conversion, a full approval, a permanent rule, a licence in the holder's own name, filed while the parent still stands; conversion is slow enough that it must begin while the emergency looks as if it will never end, the season in which nobody begins it. Not Bar date in the newspaper, where the date is on a docket and imputed; here the date is honest and simply on a different paper. Not lead-time-floors' Calendar with nothing in it, a wait a rule imposes; here the rule does not make the holder wait, it ends.

Patch before seven. The option ends by the holder's own development, on a timetable the holder cannot read, so its keeping belongs to another pair of hands. Amblyopia is most correctable by patching the good eye in the first years and answers less, and less completely, after about seven, though the trials of the 2000s found some response into the early teens; the clubfoot cast in infancy; the second language spoken without an accent, argued over as a hard window; the duckling that imprints in its first day. Lost: a capability, the cortex's willingness to rewire. Carrier: the developmental timetable. Threshold: about seven for the eye, soft at the edges. Tell: the holder gives none; a parent notices a squint, or a preschool vision check does. Changed next move: screening; where there is no programme the option goes out unseen at a rate that is a property of the programme and not of the child. Beside Last known well, where a witness dates the option; here the holder cannot be its own witness at all. Not a use-it-or-lose-it: nothing the child does or leaves undone runs this clock faster or slower.

Last known well. The option is dated by the last witness to the fact rather than by the fact, so it runs out when the proof runs out while the tissue might still allow it. The woman who wakes with the deficit is ineligible for thrombolysis because the four-and-a-half-hour window is counted from when she was last seen well, which was bedtime, so the wake-up stroke loses the drug whenever the artery actually closed; the opened vial with no time on its label and the sample with a gap in its chain of custody are both treated as expired at the earliest moment they could have been. Lost: a capability, a treatment the protocol now forbids. Carrier: the protocol's timestamp rule, which asks for a witness and not for the tissue. Threshold: the window measured from the last witness. Tell: the paper says no while the body has not been asked. Changed next move: a witness; someone awake, a time written on the vial, or the imaging that reads the tissue's own clock, by which the WAKE-UP trial of 2018 gave the drug back to patients with no witnessed onset. Beside witness-architectures, which asks what must exist for a trace to form; this is the option that dies for want of a trace while the fact would still have allowed it. Not Patch before seven, where the body's own clock has run; here the body's clock may not have run at all, and the record's has.

The situation resolves faster than the forum that would decide it can move, so nobody declines and nobody rules. The student whose challenge to a law school's admissions was dismissed as moot because he was about to graduate (DeFunis, 1974); the pregnancy over before the appeal; the election held before the ballot-access case; the tenant evicted before the housing court sits; the employee whose grievance is mooted by the reorganization that abolished the post. Lost: a permission, the justiciability of the claim. Carrier: the ratio of the forum's pace to the harm's duration, a number nobody at the table sets. Threshold: the harm ends before the ruling. Tell: there is no date anywhere in it. Changed next move: not speed, since hurrying does not save this one, but a structure that outlives the individual harm: the class certified before the named plaintiff's harm ends, which Sosna (1975) allowed, or the doctrine that a harm capable of repetition yet evading review may be decided anyway, on which Roe rested; kept by a coordination or a rule, never by hurrying. Not deal-deaths' Cost of the last mile, where surplus is eaten along a curve; here nothing is eaten, the harm is simply over. Not Bar date in the newspaper.

Session ends. The body that could have approved reaches the end of its own term with the matter still pending, and its successor starts it at zero. Bills die on adjournment sine die and must be reintroduced from the first line; the treaty signed and waiting on a parliament that is dissolved; the permit application before a council that is re-elected; the approval the old board agreed in the hallway and had not minuted when the board was reconstituted at the meeting; the offer approved by a committee the reorganization disbands. Expires: the matter's place in the process. Lost: a counterparty, the particular body whose yes was there for the taking. Carrier: the ratifier's own calendar, its election, its session, its term. Threshold: adjournment or reconstitution with the matter pending. Tell: no recorded no anywhere. Changed next move: the vote scheduled before adjournment, the carry-over motion, the approval minuted rather than agreed in the hallway; the small clerical acts that let a warm yes survive the people who gave it. The treaty cases are simplified, since most unratified treaties were eventually refused by someone; the clean form is the legislative bill, which dies by the thousand each session with no recorded no. Beside deal-deaths' Ratifier's other deal, where the ratifier wanted a different bargain; this is the ratifier that wanted this one and was gone before the vote. Not Landlord changes, where the counterparty is replaced by a transfer; here it is replaced by the calendar.

Landlord changes. An option held in a person rather than on the paper that transfers ends at the counterparty's next transfer, which the holder does not control and often does not see. The renewal promised by the landlord who sells the building to a buyer not bound by unrecorded promises; the 'we'll take you back' from a manager who moves on; the side letter with a fund's partner that the successor manager has never seen; the supplier's verbal priority that walks out with the account executive. Lost: a counterparty, the one whose word held the option. Carrier: the register, the deed, the fund agreement, the offer letter on letterhead, on which the option was never written, so the successor takes free of it. Threshold: the transfer. Tell: the promise lives in a person and appears on no transferring paper. Changed next move: recording; a memorandum of option on the title, a side letter countersigned by the entity, the promise put on the paper that binds successors. The cost is not money but the awkwardness of asking a friendly counterparty to bind their own unknown replacement. Beside term-sheet-powers' Successor in the chair, where the replacement exercises a term the friend would not have; this is the mirror, the replacement who declines to honour a term the friend gave. Not Chair grown over, where the counterparty stays and the shape goes.

Chair grown over. The option to return rests on a vacancy the counterparty has not yet re-planned, so it ends at the counterparty's next planning cycle with nobody declining the return. The leave taken with no return date whose post is shared out among three people at the next reorganization; the budget line reallocated at year end; the supplier's line retooled for the customer who stayed; the co-founder's seat the remaining founders stop leaving empty at the next hire. Expires: the return to the seat; employment there afterward is a new negotiation from the outside, as a stranger would make it. Lost: a capability on the counterparty's side, the shape that could have received the holder. Carrier: the counterparty's planning cadence, quarterly, annual, the next reorganization, which sets the day without reference to the holder. Threshold: the cycle turning. Tell: the absence is absorbed the way skin closes over a small cut; no one opposes the return. Changed next move: a dated return, a leave rather than a resignation, a reservation the cycle must respect, or the return itself before the cycle turns. Beside traces-of-the-unlived's Vacancy tenant, where preparation for a future breeds its opponents; here no one opposes and the absence is simply absorbed. Not forms-of-return's Reentry burn, a road open and hostile one way; this road has closed.

An option that requires many simultaneous yeses ends unless the gathering outruns the decay of each yes; a coordination has a half-life. The recall petition whose signatures older than sixty days are invalid under Michigan's rule, or must all fall within California's hundred and sixty days; the tender offer's minimum condition that must be met by the offer's expiry; the crowd in the square that goes home; the reunion that becomes impossible one death at a time. Lost: a coordination. Carrier: the validity window on each act of assent, written by the rule or by the assenter's own attention, which wanders. Threshold: the gathering rate falls below the decay rate. Tell: the early yeses expiring before the last one arrives. Changed next move: a gathering rate; paid circulators, a date agreed in advance, a pact that binds the early yeses until the last arrives, so the first to say yes are not asked to hold still forever. The recall and the tender are observed; the crowd is an analogy. Beside who-can-be-bound's Place in line, an ordering lost by leaving; this is the coordination lost by others' leaving. Not Session ends, where one body's calendar kills the matter; here many small calendars do.

The holder's own growth moves the natural acquirer out of reach, so the option to sell ends at the round that prices the company above what the acquirer can pay at all: a market capitalization smaller than the price, a wage cap, a fund's concentration limit, and past those a board's approval ceiling, with nobody at either table saying no. The company whose preference stack now exceeds the largest deal its three strategic buyers have ever done; the player whose wage outgrows every club in the league but two; the practice too large for any partner to buy in and too small to be listed. Lost: a counterparty, the buyer whose capacity was the option. Carrier: the acquirer's capacity, readable in its market value and deal history, set against the holder's price, which each round raises. Threshold: the price crossing the acquirer's ceiling. Tell: the acquirer's deal history, read against the holder's next price. Changed next move: the sale at the last price under the ceiling, which was never seen as the last, or a round sized to stay under it, the one choice a founder is never advised to make. Analytical: every observed case can be read as a buyer that would have paid more, so it stands as a mechanism and not a count. Beside market-deaths' Slowed past the rot, where a market thins from the outside; this is the market for the holder that the holder thins by growing. Not Chair grown over, where the counterparty re-plans; here the counterparty is unchanged and the holder has left its range.

Pour the foundation. A permission about to be taken away by a third party's rule change can be kept only by an act in the world that no paper substitutes for. The building may go ahead under the old zoning only if the developer has substantially begun, in reliance on a valid permit, before the ordinance passes; the footings poured the week of the council vote; the nonconforming use that survives the new code only if actually in use on the effective date; the grandfathered rate kept only by the account that was open. Lost: a permission. Carrier: the code together with the vested-rights doctrine, which in most states vests on construction begun and in a few, as in Washington, on a complete application, so the last act differs by jurisdiction, and the holder who knows which applies has a different week from the holder who does not. Threshold: the ordinance's effective date. Tell: the vote on the calendar and the rule for what vests. Changed next move: the hole in the ground before the vote, an exercise begun rather than a filing made; the option is preserved only by starting to use it. Beside first-mover-forecloses, which holds the rival who changes the rules on purpose; this is the rule that changes for reasons of its own, with no one aiming at the holder. Not Slot flown empty, where the exercise must be repeated; here one beginning vests it for good.

Slot flown empty. The permission ends by disuse and is kept only by exercise, so the clock runs while the holder does nothing and stops when the holder acts, and the act that preserves it is the exercise emptied of its purpose. The airport slot that must be flown eighty percent of the season or handed back, which had airlines flying empty aircraft in early 2020 until the rule was waived; the water right under prior appropriation forfeited after five years without beneficial use, which has fields irrigated in a drought to keep them; the trade mark abandoned after three years' non-use; the mining claim kept by annual labour; the department budget spent in the last quarter so it is not cut. Lost: a permission. Carrier: the regulator's usage ledger. Threshold: eighty percent of the season, five years, three years, the annual labour, the quarter's end. Tell: the ledger itself. Changed next move: the empty flight, which costs the whole price of using the option and gives back nothing but the option, so keeping and using are the same act and the upkeep is the exercise price. Beside runway-illusions' Stamp's clock, whose licence lapses without hours logged and which no cash extends; this is the price at which it can be extended after all, the hours flown for nobody. Beside tollgates-that-must-buy's Stamp with an expiry, where the gate must spend its stamp; this is the permission-holder who must burn the permission to keep it. Beside power-trades' Leased strike, where disuse makes a power unbelieved; this is the disuse that forfeits it by rule. Not Pour the foundation, one act that vests; here no act finishes the keeping, it must be done again for as long as the holder wants to hold it.

Thawed to be ready. Preparing to exercise the option begins a decay the unprepared state did not have, so the option to wait ends because the option to act was made ready. The vaccine vial that keeps for months frozen, weeks once thawed, and hours once punctured; the epoxy whose pot life begins at mixing; the drawn dose; the armed fuze; the reagent brought to room temperature; the opened surgical field; the reserve army that cannot be held at the frontier through the harvest it was drawn from. Lost: a capability, the good itself spoiling in its ready state. Carrier: a chemistry, or a season, that starts at preparation. Threshold: the preparation. Tell: readiness itself. Changed next move: not preparing, or preparing in the smallest unit; the single-dose vial, the small mix, the tranche thawed for the day's bookings. The clinic that thaws a whole tray to be sure of serving whoever comes has bought its readiness with the doses it pours out at closing. The mirror of Slot flown empty, which dies of not being touched; this dies of being touched, and a holder of both must burn the one and refrain from readying the other. Not lead-time-floors' Understudy, a finished copy waiting, which does not spoil for having been rehearsed. Not Kept on the machine, where the harm falls on the holder and is billed by the day; here it falls on the good.

The option must be taken before any other move on a linked matter, so its clock is the holder's own next act rather than a date: a holder who does nothing keeps it, a holder who does anything adjacent loses it. The objection to the court's jurisdiction over the defendant, waived if left out of the first response; the patent dead in Europe on the morning of the conference talk and a year later in the United States; the appeal waived by accepting the settlement; the election of remedies; the defect in the goods that must be objected to before the goods are used; the 'speak now' at the wedding. Lost: a permission. Carrier: a rule that binds the option to a position in a sequence, written in a different place from the option, in the rules of procedure, the patent statute, the sales code, so the holder learns the order from the loss. Threshold: the first adjacent act. Tell: none before the loss; the sequence is written where the holder was not looking. Changed next move: the ordering itself; the provisional application filed the morning of the talk, the reservation written into the first filing, the objection lodged before the goods are unpacked, each costing nothing but the knowledge that an order exists. Not Slot flown empty, where the holder's inaction runs the clock; here inaction is the only thing that keeps it. Not Bar date in the newspaper; there is no date, and the holder is the only one who can strike.

The option to reverse a move ends at the first act the new state performs that the old state cannot read, so the window is the pause between the change and its first consequence, and it closes without anyone deciding to close it. The migration that can be rolled back until the new service writes its first record in a shape the old schema rejects; the merger reversible until the first combined payroll; the new address reversible until the first piece of mail arrives; the reorganization reversible until the first hire is made into the new chart; the currency changeover until the first contract is written in the new unit. Lost: a capability, the old state's ability to take over from here. Carrier: the first write, which the new state performs in the ordinary course of its life and which is not a decision about the reversal at all. Threshold: the first write. Tell: the new state doing one ordinary thing the old cannot understand. Changed next move: the expand-and-contract shape, writing to both for a season so the old can still read, at the price of running two and of a season in which neither is the truth. Beside pivot-invariants, which name the retained assets that make leaving cheap; this is the moment one of them is lost. Beside undo-costs, which bills a reversal that remains possible; this is the reversal that stops being possible. Not Thawed to be ready, where readiness spoils the good; here the new state's use closes the way back to the old.

Kept on the machine. The option is held open by a device or an upkeep whose own running accumulates a harm, or whose lapse is one-way, so the deadline is the machine's and not the situation's. The patient on ECMO as a bridge to transplant who becomes ineligible for the transplant the circuit was keeping her alive for, since bleeding, infection, and clotting rise with each week on circuit and centres set a duration beyond which candidacy is reviewed; the mothballed mine kept dry by pumps whose stopping floods the workings past reopening; the ship in the reserve fleet whose hull is kept by cathodic protection a budget line can end; the interim chief who has run the company past the point where the search can bring in an outsider. Lost: a capability, the eligibility or the workings. Carrier: the bridge itself, its complication rate or its upkeep bill. Threshold: the centre's duration limit, the budget line, the point past which the search cannot bring an outsider. Tell: weeks on circuit; the upkeep bill. Changed next move: a listing at the moment of cannulation, a search begun the day the interim was named, a decision to stop pumping taken while a sale was still possible; treat the bridge's first day as the option's deadline rather than its reprieve. The ECMO limits are centre practice and are simplified. Beside lead-time-floors' Bridge, a degraded replacement priced by the hour; this is the bridge that ends the option it holds open. Not Standstill with a term, where the clock is a date the counterparty signs; here the clock is a harm nobody signs.

Standstill with a term. A pause taken to keep an option open is written on an instrument with a term, so a situation that had no deadline acquires one, and the paper's renewal belongs to the counterparty, who now knows what the pause is worth to the holder. The tolling agreement that stops the limitations clock the holder could have stopped alone by filing, and runs out in twelve months unless the adversary signs again; the negotiated leave of absence that dates a job which had no date and is extended only if the employer signs; the forbearance agreement that holds the lender's foreclosure for ninety days; the furlough whose recall rights run six months; the standstill in a takeover that keeps the bidder from buying shares and ends on the day it says. Lost: a permission, the leave to remain in the paused state. Carrier: the pause's own instrument, the only clock in the whole situation the holder wrote with their own hand. Threshold: the instrument's term. Tell: the counterparty has just learned how much this matters to the holder. Changed next move: the renewal asked for before the counterparty learns it is needed, or a pause written without a term, which is rarely granted; the Korean armistice has no renewal date and is still called temporary. Set aside the statutory pauses: the twelve weeks of the family-leave statute and the restraining order's fourteen days are the same date without the mechanism, since the term is a rule's and the renewal belongs to a court or to no one, so the holder gets the deadline without paying the counterparty for it; those are runway-illusions' Stamp's clock. Beside impasse-inventions' cooling-off right, reversibility offered as a chip; this is the bill the chip carries. Not lead-time-floors' No-shop, which serializes the search; here the search is stopped, and the stopping is what expires.
